entries.why: Sidebar portal status (pairs completed out of the prospective universe), computed from the registry for the whole portal; not a pair result.
Fixed display band of the probability-engine chart (template constant, the same for every pair), not a result.
Reference list entries (journal volume(issue), pages; publication year): bibliographic metadata, not results.
Trade-log definitions in the shared template: weight range 0-100 percent and the fixed $10,000 notional stake the broker-style log uses (a template constant, the same for every pair).

entries.regex: \bseven-part structure\b|\bLevel [12]\b|\btwo tiers\b|\bRows 2 and 4\b|\bthese two tables\b|\bthe two data views\b|\bThe two differ\b|\bTwo files\b|\bfirst 10 executions\b|\b10-column schema\b
entries.why: Page and table structure (section counts, tier names, row references, file counts): template layout, the same for every pair.

entries.regex: \bbetween 100% and 0%|\b100% (?:cash|SPY|XLV|XLP|XLI)\b|\brun of three neighbouring leads\b|\bround trip is two (?:executions|rows)\b
entries.why: How a P1 long/cash rule and the stable lead range work (full exposure or cash; a window of three adjacent leads): method mechanics, not a pair result.
Transaction-cost convention of every backtest (5 bp per execution, two per round trip): methodology constant.
The threshold rule's definition (window and percentile of the rolling boundary), parsed from the threshold code (components.rolling_threshold): the rule's parameters, not a measured result.
Signal display name (window of the transform), from the pair's declared signal labels: a parameter, not a result.
Official definition of the delinquency series (FRED DRCCLACBN): data definition, not a result.
Names of NBER recessions (episode labels from the track summary's coverage list), not results.
Diagnostic of the trigger-card illustration (how many of the three illustrated crossings were found in the signal history), not a research result.
